function deleteStringIndex(value: {readonly [key:string]:number}, key:string) { delete value[key]; }
function deleteNumberIndex(value: {readonly [key:number]:number}, key:number) { delete value[key]; }
function deleteNumericStringIndex(value: {readonly [key:string]:number}, key:number) { delete value[key]; }
const emptyRequired: {"":number} = {"":1};
delete emptyRequired[""];
const emptyReadonly: {readonly ""?:number} = {};
delete emptyReadonly[""];
function deleteUnionIndex(value: {readonly [key:string]:number}|{[key:string]:number}, key:string) { delete value[key]; }
function deleteReadonlyArray(value: readonly number[], key:number) { delete value[key]; }
function deleteReadonlyUnionProperty(value:{readonly x?:number}|{x?:number}) { delete value.x; }
function deleteNumericLiteral(value: {readonly [key:number]:number}) { delete value["0"]; }
function deleteMixedIndex(value: {readonly [key:number]:number;[key:string]:number}, key:string|number) { delete value[key]; }
